[[File:Coruscant_abandoned_tower.png|thumb|right|250px|The Dacho District was the most infamous Dead Sector.]]
'''Dead Sectors''' were areas of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that had been removed from the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power grid]].<ref name="Insider 65">{{InsiderCite|65|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones'': Dark Rendezvous}}</ref>

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[722 BBY]], the [[Dacho District]] was the site of a catastrophic industrial accident that resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of 300,000 trapped workers. As many of the bodies were sealed behind collapsed sections and considered unrecoverable, the district held the unpleasant distinction of being [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] largest tomb and became the most infamous of Coruscant's Dead Sectors.<ref name="Insider 65" />
